title: clematis occidentalis subsp. dissecta
intro: Clematis occidentalis subsp. dissecta, commonly known as Western Virgin's Bower, is a plant species in the Ranunculaceae family. It is primarily used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of Western Virgin's Bower include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
